Druid Android Linux Studio is an open-source development environment for Android and Linux. It combines guided workflows for beginners, advanced development tools, device and SDK management, Android build workflows, emulator integration, and developer diagnostics. ## What's coming – The next generation of Druid Studio

The upcoming stable release of Druid / Android Linux Studio introduces a major expansion of the development environment.

**New capabilities in development:**

- **Four integrated workspaces:** A clearer, more structured development experience.
- **Local AI Workspace:** A dedicated AI environment powered by Libre AuroraUI.
- **AI-assisted coding:** Context-aware coding support integrated into the developer workspace.
- **Advanced Android integration:** Expanded device management, ADB tools and emulator workflows.
- **Improved user experience:** More consistent navigation, clearer workflows and improved usability.

Our goal is to bring traditional Android and Linux development tools together with local AI assistance in one coherent, community-oriented environment.

These capabilities are being refined and integrated for the upcoming stable release.

projects.name: engdev/satellite-simulation
projects.description:
Satellite Simulation Framework is an open-source project focused on developing a modular and extensible satellite simulation platform using Unreal Engine 5 and C++. The goal is to model satellite behavior, orbital mechanics, payloads, sensors, communication systems, and the space environment within a realistic, high-fidelity simulation.

This repository demonstrates the complete software engineering lifecycle behind building a professional simulation system. Development follows industry best practices, including systems engineering, software architecture, requirements management, documentation, issue tracking, Git workflows, code reviews, continuous integration (CI/CD), automated testing, and incremental feature development.

The project is organized around GitLab milestones, issues, feature branches, and merge requests to reflect the workflow of a professional engineering team. The architecture emphasizes modularity, scalability, maintainability, and future extensibility, enabling support for multiple satellite constellations, mission planning, visualization, AI-driven behaviors, and operator training.

This repository serves both as an educational resource and as a professional portfolio demonstrating software engineering, simulation development, and modern DevOps practices through the implementation of a complex, real-world simulation framework.

projects.name: international-duck-incorporated/Beacon
projects.description:
Beacon is a modular, client-side utility mod for Minecraft 26.2 built for Fabric, providing a broad collection of quality-of-life, rendering, world, utility, and fun features in a single lightweight client modification.

Beacon is designed around a strict vanilla-server-safe approach. The project intentionally excludes combat automation, movement automation, ESP and wallhack functionality, and server exploits. Its focus is instead on improving the everyday Minecraft client experience through configurable utilities, visual enhancements, quality-of-life improvements, and additional client-side functionality.

The mod includes features across five main categories: Render, World, Utility, Fun, and Misc. It also provides a modular architecture with configuration persistence, keybind support, the `/beacon` command, an addon API, and support for enabling and configuring modules through the Beacon configuration system.

Beacon is intended for developers and players who want an extensible client-side utility mod for Minecraft 26.2, with an emphasis on maintainability, configurable features, and compatibility with vanilla servers. The project includes dedicated verification and development tooling for areas such as the user interface, configuration handling, and Freecam functionality.

Beacon is open source and distributed under the GNU General Public License v3 for the combined work, with additional attribution and licensing information provided for original and third-party components.

projects.name: openstatute/openstatute-profile
projects.description:
OpenStatute is an initiative led by Anbarasan, a Legal-Tech entrepreneur who is also an Advocate by profession. OpenStatute aims to collate Indian statutes and provide up-to-date information with the help of the community. Inspired by platforms like GitLab and GitHub, OpenStatute adopts a collaborative model and version control system to effectively capture all amendments in a versionized manner.
OpenStatute utilizes GitLab as its foundation and leverages the open-source project support provided by GitLab. By using GitLab's infrastructure, OpenStatute ensures that all changes and updates to the statutes are tracked, documented, and easily accessible. This approach allows users to view the historical development of statutes and understand the specific amendments that have been made over time.
Similar to how GitLab and GitHub enable collaboration and version control for software development projects, OpenStatute extends this concept to the legal domain. By providing a platform for legal professionals, experts, and the general community to contribute and maintain an accurate and up-to-date repository of Indian statutes, OpenStatute aims to improve access to legal information and enhance transparency within the legal system.
Overall, OpenStatute combines the collaborative power of GitLab, the open-source project support from GitLab, and the expertise of legal professionals to create a comprehensive and continually evolving resource for Indian statutes.
🙌 Your support can make a significant difference! 🌟
As a not-for-profit initiative, OpenStatute relies on the collective efforts of individuals like you to thrive and fulfill our mission. Our commitment is to provide free and open access to all gazettes and reliable sources that document recent changes in statutes. By doing so, we aim to serve as an educational resource, fostering transparency and offering a single point of reference for all statute materials.
